verdict.comment: Consistent performer DARE TO SHOUT has bumped into some progressive sorts here this winter and can return to winning ways.

comments.cadell: Impressed in 3-runner novice at Wetherby in November and possible excuses the next twice
comments.daretoshout: Has run well when second the last twice; likes it here and he's a solid candidate
comments.mrincredible: On a handy mark but can refuse to race, which was the case on stable debut in December
comments.pullagaingreen: Bad mistake when well beaten in December; in good form previously and could be in the mix
comments.yourownstory: Often finishes second (including here) and might not be far away if returning to form

races.raceComment: daretoshout is marginally preferred with a score of 58.9%, holding clear edges in superior course form over pullagaingreen. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 4 wins from 15 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Excellent course form of 5/17 at kelso. Key attributes include strong course form, though step up in class and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Topweight DAARIS is weighted to gain revenge on Mamdoh, who pipped him by a nose over C&D last month.

comments.abstract: Back from long absence with four underwhelming 1m4f runs this year
comments.arczoosve: 0-9 for Ivan Furtado but placed three times over 1m6f towards end of 2024; stable debut
comments.courageousgold: Unplaced favourite on debut and two heavy defeats have followed; remains very unexposed
comments.daaris: In good form over staying trips on Tapeta since the autumn and current mark is workable
comments.grandduchessolga: Disappointed last time but this largely consistent mare went close over C&D two runs ago
comments.lumberjack: 0-14; placed three times this winter but needs to find something extra to open his account
comments.majormajor: Narrow 1m2f winner in January but well held since; yet fully to convince over 1m6f
comments.mamdoh: Dual C&D winner last month and went close over C&D ten days ago; obvious contender
comments.princehector: Won tactical 1m4f classified race here last week (1m4f); back up in grade today
comments.somebodycomegether: 66-1 second on soft going in the autumn but struggled when back on Tapeta

races.raceComment: mamdoh is marginally preferred with a score of 54.9%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over daaris. Won 2 of last 6 starts. verdict.comment: Rebecca's Girl has been running with credit but MAYO COUNTY (nap) won easily here last time and can defy her 7lb rise.

comments.courtdrive: Impressed at Kempton in January but held under a penalty 11 days later; now 1lb higher
comments.danzart: Several good runs last year but failed to fire when last seen and has an absence to defy
comments.littlemuddy: Run well fresh in the last two years but out of form when last seen; bit to prove
comments.lordabama: Last seen winning a C&D handicap in November; could progress further this year
comments.matchplay: Ran poorly 11 days ago; now tried in a hood; dangerous mark but not solid at this trip
comments.mayocounty: Easy C&D win 12 days ago (second run after a wind op); up 7lb; big chance for red-hot yard
comments.mightypower: Low-key stable debut 11 days ago; down in the weights but others look safer
comments.nazca: Back to his last winning mark but doesn't look in good enough form to take advantage
comments.orientalprince: Won four of his last six starts; still improving and greatly respected despite a 4lb rise
comments.rebeccasgirl: Three course wins this winter; placed on her last two starts; should go well once again

verdict.comment: Tantomile can go well back up in trip but URBAN DANDY may be able to follow up his recent 1m win here.

comments.bellapuledra: Poor form claims but this is her first realistic opportunity and she has headgear fitted
comments.coppermountain: Not found top form after a break but she's capable at this level; each-way claims
comments.dandylichious: Slow start caused issues last time & better judged on earlier placed efforts in January
comments.marcellosi: Three course wins in the first half of 2024; more promise in recent starts; new headgear
comments.martinsbrig: Comes here in good form, albeit at 1m; may face competition for the lead but respected
comments.rainbowmirage: Only occasional promise since 2022; not easily recommended
comments.secretdaay: Took his record to 0-33 when well beaten here on Thursday (6f); hard to fancy
comments.sharktwoone: 0-13 last year but down in grade for his return; usual headgear absent; betting to guide
comments.tantomile: 6f win at Southwell this month; solid run in a Class 5 h'cap latest; big player up to 7f
comments.twobtanned: Beaten 20l+ in two 1m2f handicaps for G Scott; down in trip/grade on stable debut; chance
comments.urbandandy: Easy win in a 1m classified event here 12 days ago; solid claims in another weak race
comments.willowbaby: Exposed maiden whose best form has come over shorter; ran poorly over 5f last month

races.raceComment: martinsbrig is marginally preferred with a score of 49.0%. Won 1 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Filly One is an interesting contender down in trip and class but FRANK THE SPARK is taken to build on his promising reappearance.

comments.above: Hard-fought C&D win in January; respectable efforts since; shouldn't be too far away
comments.darkkestrel: Solid run when second over C&D nine days ago; can miss the break but still of interest
comments.darlopride: Conditions fine and continues to run with credit; shouldn't be too far away once again
comments.fierce: 2 wins for the Moores but inconsistent in 2024; sold for 1,000gns in October; had wind op
comments.fillyone: 2-2 at Newcastle (both 6f); down in trip/class and this unexposed filly could go well
comments.frankthespark: Progressive in 2024; made a promising reappearance behind Ganesha two weeks ago; contender
comments.ganesha: Wind op in December has worked the oracle; beat two of these over C&D 15 days ago; solid
comments.goldenrainbow: Conditions to suit and outran his 50-1 odds here last month; others stronger for the win
comments.kingscrown: Comes here in good form but others would appear to have more upside
comments.southshore: Struggled for current yard, including on reappearance; down in weights but lots to prove
comments.wrestlingrevenue: Two Brighton wins for T Carroll in 2024; finished last in 2 C&D runs for this yard in Jan

races.raceComment: darlopride is marginally preferred with a score of 62.0%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more reliable profile over ganesha. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
